title: The Pen Still Has Work
concept: Two distinct preparation tools deliver useful outputs to two distinct professional actions. One articulated pen carries an ordinary physical callback and finally marks an editable draft.

fingerprint.metaphor: a capped pen becomes a held writing instrument after two different office tools deliver their work

treatment.scope: Phase 4.1 selection and concrete treatment repair only. No storyboard, VO lock or scene code.
treatment.verdict: LOCK REVISED TREATMENT; BUILD AND RENDER PROOF STILL REQUIRED
treatment.locked_angle: In the KGS workflows described by AWS, the machine’s finished output is still unfinished professional work.
treatment.stance: Curious and appreciative of concrete preparation. The pen title names its pictured activity, never employment or preserved jobs.
treatment.rationale: The Dramatist changes both material and professional verb near 80 seconds, has the clearest physical workrooms and a shelf pen that can gain real cap/contact states. Its draft does not pass unchanged. This replacement abandons delayed knowledge of the human role, ends the promised pair with the second action, and uses an independent ordinary prop action rather than an unchanged status label for the other loop.

mandatory_repairs_resolved.blocker: Human role was hidden or falsely treated as a late revelation.
mandatory_repairs_resolved.resolution: Show an ordinary professional hand in the first eight seconds and explicitly promise two different professional actions by 15 seconds. Human participation is never withheld.

mandatory_repairs_resolved.blocker: READY suffix and persistent FIRST DRAFT counted as late discoveries.
mandatory_repairs_resolved.resolution: Retire READY as hero and all suffix installation scenes. FIRST DRAFT remains a continuous status obligation. The primary payoff is completion of a promised demonstration, not discovery of a hidden caveat.

mandatory_repairs_resolved.blocker: Both loops answered the same broad question.
mandatory_repairs_resolved.resolution: The primary promises the pair of report examination and generated-section refinement. The separate secondary is only a physical cap reattachment: an ordinary object callback, with no claim about workflow outcomes. Its payoff does not supply either workflow answer.

mandatory_repairs_resolved.blocker: Pen state list was mostly positions.
mandatory_repairs_resolved.resolution: Use five inspectable cap/nib/grip/contact configurations below. Travel, rotation, ownership language and a persistent collar do not count as state change.

mandatory_repairs_resolved.blocker: Late synthesis consumed eleven seconds without new work.
mandatory_repairs_resolved.resolution: After the second action, allow at most a compact three-second moving comparison before returning to current-announcement scope. No long four-label tableau or second READY conclusion.
Story remains 112-130 seconds, target120 with 200-220 future VO words. Append a separate12.3-second credit sequence.

revised_treatment.logline: One ordinary pen follows two useful office outputs into two different professional actions, making the boundary between preparation and completion visible.
revised_treatment.cold_open_first_3_seconds: A neat report rises from an illustrative output slot and gives one fully capped oxblood pen a short, elegant pivot. The cap stays attached. A rapid pullback finds the professional hand and a separate work surface by eight seconds. No failure cue or implied final award.
revised_treatment.escalation: The named KGS September11 announcement and Koniag/Kodiak connection locate the story. The film then enters an explicitly earlier AWS Army example. DORA retrieves records through APIs and prebuilt logic; a separate Jumpstarter uses LLM drafting. Both mechanisms are clear before58seconds. Their useful report and editable draft are granted full foreground space. The final act follows different professional work on each material, completing the pair near94seconds.
revised_treatment.turn: The strongest objection is that the machines really have completed useful preparation. Let both outputs be solid, organized and present while their machinery recedes. Then show refinement of a generated section and examination of a separate report. Neither contribution disappears; no bad result is needed.

button.line: When the output is ready, which job is finished?
button.image: Match the opening pen silhouette, now posted and visibly used in the ordinary professional’s hand. Keep the report and still-labeled FIRST DRAFT as separate supporting materials. The earlier neutral ink mark survives; no signature or award.

act3_test.name: Two Outputs, Two Professional Actions
act3_test.strongest_fair_case: An assembled report and editable generated section are completed preparation, so calling all work unfinished would unfairly erase what the tools did.
act3_test.drawn_test: At60-66seconds machinery recedes and the two prepared materials take the foreground. At66-82seconds the professional selects and neutrally refines generated language. At83-95seconds a different close view shows examination of the separate DORA report for determination. No error, delay, specific vendor decision or final approval is depicted.
act3_test.what_changes_at80: Switch from editing generated prose to examining gathered information, with a new material, gesture and camera scale.
act3_test.nature: Source-described workflow comparison illustrated editorially; not an empirical performance trial.

primary_loop.promise: Follow these two useful outputs into the two different actions the professional performs.
primary_loop.partial_fulfillment: The generated section receives a visible neutral refinement; the report action remains to be demonstrated.
primary_loop.payoff: The professional opens and examines the separate DORA report for determination, completing the promised pair. This is completion of the illustration, not completion of a procurement or an actual determination.
primary_loop.honesty: Name the human role early. Both mechanisms and output types are explained before the midpoint. No secret source fact or late qualification is needed.

secondary_loop.promise: A clearly detached cap and its matching rear posting socket form a small physical pairing: the cap will rejoin the pen when the hand prepares to use it.
secondary_loop.plant_picture: For one brief beat the hand turns the loose cap above the pen’s open rear socket, exposing matching shapes, then places it beside the pen and the film cuts onward. The cap is intact and moves freely.
secondary_loop.payoff: The hand retrieves the cap and seats it on the pen’s rear in an ordinary deliberate action before the refinement gesture.
secondary_loop.independence: This answers where an ordinary prop component fits; it does not answer what the two professional jobs are. It is a physical comedy callback, not a new fact or claimed malfunction.
secondary_loop.anti_wait_rule: Never hold a cap or hand frozen between49and76seconds. Intervening shots cover other explanation. Montage does not represent literal elapsed review time; the cap never blocks output, review or a person. If this ordinary action is not unmistakably planted, the loop fails and must be revised before voice.

angle.thesis: In the KGS workflows described by AWS, the machine's finished output is still unfinished professional work.
angle.valence: Curious with earned credit for concrete preparation tools. The film examines useful work and a real human handoff without a claimed productivity verdict.
angle.falsifiability: A workflow trace showing DORA reports or Jumpstarter sections used as final determinations or approvals without the documented professional action would contradict the claimed boundary. Attribute the workflow to AWS rather than certifying compliance in all production uses.
supporting_facts: The September 11th KGS announcement describes Wingman support and links its foundations to earlier Army automation.
AWS describes DORA retrieving compliance records via APIs and applying prebuilt logic, then returning a report for professional review and determination.
Separate Jumpstarter tools generate initial sections through LLMs, and people refine and approve those sections.
angle.fair_counterpoint: An assembled record and an editable draft are concrete preparation outputs worth crediting. Their arrival doesn't independently establish net productivity or a completed procurement. Do not invent an error, review delay or failure to dramatize the boundary.
angle.alaska_connection: KGS is a subsidiary of Koniag, the regional Alaska Native corporation associated with Kodiak. This announcement does not quantify Alaska returns. No tribal-government or cultural characterization.
angle.second_movement: Establish retrieval/rules and generative drafting before the midpoint. Act 3 follows what the professional actually does with each output, then the ending changes the viewer's test from whether a page exists to which job is finished.
angle.story_question: What's still unfinished when the machine's output is ready?
angle.numbers_decision: Cut c15 stopwatch and c16/c17 portfolio totals. They distract from the output-versus-decision boundary and invite unproved timing arithmetic. Dates remain provenance.

runner_up_angles.why_lost: Editorial ranking is not falsifiable; shared speeding claim overextended task evidence. Retain concrete professional boundary.
Better lacks a measured quality axis. Retain assembled report and editable draft as tangible outputs.

runner_up_angles.angle: C measured speed and head start
runner_up_angles.why_lost: No independent net-productivity test; DORA timing cannot measure generative drafting. Retain early technical distinction.

divergence_note: The last two films follow a medicine flight crate and a student EEG notebook. This film uses a long articulated pen, corporate identity wall, horizontal retrieval cutaway and a separate vertical drafting table. The precise physical distinction between a gathered report and generative paragraphs drives new compositions; the copper and porcelain office receives outputs warmly, with an oxblood diagonal tool in front. It is authored from scratch, with shelf components cast into different worlds.
